founderLanding.title: Let's build the home of Amazigh and Algerian cinema together
founderLanding.subtitle: Tamurt Vidéo is under construction. Become a founding member for €2 a month and support the birth of a streaming platform dedicated to our films, our series and our audiovisual heritage.
founderLanding.honesty: During the founding phase, the subscription supports development: it does not give access to a catalogue of commercial films until the corresponding rights have been acquired.
founderLanding.why1Text: Every title is streamed with the agreement of its rights holders, so that the people who create it are paid.
founderLanding.why2Text: Kabyle, Algerian Arabic, Tamazight, French: works in their own languages, with carefully crafted subtitles.
founderLanding.why3Text: Funded by its members and by the Tamurt Services ecosystem, without depending on a large media group.
founderLanding.benefit1: The Founding member badge and your membership number
founderLanding.benefit2: The member area: news, progress and roadmap
founderLanding.benefit3: Access to the announced catalogue and your wishlist
founderLanding.benefit4: Content that is already legally available
founderLanding.benefit5: When the catalogue launches, Standard access at €2 a month for as long as your subscription stays active
founderLanding.priceNote: Billed in euros (EUR). Renews automatically every month; cancel anytime from your account.
founderLanding.notDonation: This is a paid support subscription, not a donation eligible for a tax deduction.
founderLanding.founderCount: {count, plural, =0 {Be among the first founding members} one {# founding member already supports us} other {# founding members already support us}}
founderLanding.faq1Q: Can I watch films right now?
founderLanding.faq1A: Only content whose rights have already been acquired is available. The catalogue will grow with each acquisition, announced in your member area.
founderLanding.faq2Q: What happens when the Standard catalogue launches?
founderLanding.faq2A: If your founder subscription is still active, you get the Standard features while continuing to pay €2 a month instead of €10. This rate is kept for as long as you do not cancel.
founderLanding.faq3Q: Can I cancel whenever I want?
founderLanding.faq3A: Yes, in one click from your account. Access remains open until the end of the period already paid. Cancelling permanently ends the founder rate.
founderLanding.faq4A: Payments are processed by a certified provider. Tamurt Vidéo never stores your card details.
